scope: R150 follow-up: consolidated 现状 vs 上限 table and corrected 10 s arithmetic
measurement_basis: all numbers are measured: R149 event budget, R150 event-level FA decomposition, R146 standalone GEMM rates
correction: My previous statement that 10 s is unreachable because a zero-cost FA still leaves 10.42 s was logically wrong: it held every other component fixed. The correct question is what the components reach together, and S5/S6 show the answer is not trivially out of reach.

if_only_linears_improve.verdict: needs 1.75x the best rate ever measured on this host for any GEMM

if_linears_improve_and_five_overheads_ha.verdict: needs a FA kernel at or above the best measured GEMM efficiency, which is the open question for #5

conclusion: 10 s/step is not reachable by any single lever, but it is also not excluded the way I claimed last round. The realistic path needs the FA kernel to reach roughly the best efficiency measured anywhere in this workload (about 97 TFLOPS/card, from 41 today), the four linears to reach their standalone rates, and about half of the remaining overheads removed. Whether a 910A FA kernel can reach that efficiency is exactly what #5 has to answer.
